scenes.vo: Every dispatch means copying the LR number and *messaging* each customer.
Here is the *fix.* One entry updates everything.
It *copies* the LR number, *logs* the dispatch, and *messages* the customer.

params.text: Hi Sharma ji, your goods left today. Truck HR38 4521, ETA tomorrow 11 AM.

scenes.vo: The customer gets the truck and ETA. Nobody *calls* again.
Follow for one dispatch automation every day.
